story: As a Member, I want /app to take me to my dashboard, so that I have one stable entry URL that always lands somewhere useful.
expected: Opening /en/app redirects to /en/app/dashboard and the Dashboard heading is shown.

story: As a Visitor, I want /app to send me to sign in, so that I cannot reach the shell unauthenticated.
expected: Opening /en/app while signed out lands on /en/sign-in with a returnTo pointing back into the shell.

story: As a Member, I want a dashboard landing page after sign-in, so that I know I am inside the secure app.
expected: The page shows the localized Dashboard heading and a welcome line naming the product, framed by the shell chrome.

story: As a Visitor, I want to be blocked from the dashboard, so that unauthenticated users never see shell content.
expected: Opening /en/app/dashboard while signed out redirects to /en/sign-in and never shows the Dashboard heading.

story: As a Member, I want to open the Workspace area, so that I can navigate the shell beyond the dashboard.
expected: Opening /en/app/workspace shows the localized Workspace heading and a short description line.

story: As a Visitor, I want the Workspace URL to be protected, so that shell routes are not reachable while signed out.
expected: Opening /en/app/workspace while signed out redirects to /en/sign-in.

story: As a Member, I want to see all my account information at a glance, so that I can confirm who I am, my status, and what I can do.
expected: The overview shows display name, email, status badge, member-since, organizations with status badges, roles, and current permissions.

story: As a Member with no roles, I want clear empty messaging, so that a bare account does not look broken.
expected: Empty areas show localized lines: No roles assigned; You have no permissions in the active organization; You are not a member of any organization.

story: As a Member, I want to update my name and display name, so that I appear correctly across the app.
expected: Saving valid values shows the success line and the changes persist on reload; the email field stays read-only.

story: As a Member, I want the form to stop me submitting an empty name, so that I cannot blank out a required field.
expected: Submitting an empty Name shows the inline required message, marks the field invalid, and does not save.

story: As a Member, I want to change my language in Preferences, so that the app renders in my language.
expected: Choosing a different language and saving shows the success line and re-renders the UI in that language across shell pages.

story: As a Member, I want date/number/time-zone formatting to follow my choices, so that values display the way I expect.
expected: Selecting a date format, time zone, and number format and saving persists all choices across reloads; System default stores as no override.

story: As a Member, I want to change my password, so that I can keep my account secure.
expected: With correct current password and a valid matching new password, submitting changes the password, shows the confirmation, and signs out other sessions.

story: As a Member, I want to revoke a stray session, so that I can sign out a device I no longer trust.
expected: Signing out other sessions (or revoking one) updates the list and the revoked session can no longer act.

story: As a Member, I want to create an API key and copy its secret once, so that a script can call the API as me.
expected: Creating a key reveals the plaintext secret exactly once and lists the key as Active with its prefix, scopes, and metadata.

story: As a Member, I want to rotate and then revoke a key, so that I can replace a leaked secret and later retire it.
expected: Rotating reveals a new secret once and keeps the key active; revoking (after confirmation) marks it Revoked and removes its action buttons.

story: As a Member, I want to be stopped from granting scopes I do not hold, so that a key can never exceed my own permissions.
expected: The scope picker omits ungrantable scopes, and a tampered request naming an admin scope is rejected 403 with the ungrantable scopes listed.

story: As a Member, I want to browse the documentation catalog, so that I can find guidance for the platform.
expected: The landing shows available documents grouped as clickable cards, and clicking one opens its article.

story: As a Member, I want internal/maintainer docs hidden from me, so that the catalog only shows what I am meant to read.
expected: With DOCS_INTERNAL_VISIBLE false, no visibility=internal document (e.g. the UAT set) is listed in the catalog.

story: As a Member, I want to read a document with a table of contents, so that I can navigate a long article.
expected: The article shows breadcrumbs, the rendered body, an On this page list, and a Last updated line when the doc has a date.

story: As a Member, I want a hidden or unknown document to 404, so that guessing a URL never leaks a maintainer-only doc.
expected: A hidden (internal/requires), non-existent, or traversal slug returns Not Found (404), never Forbidden and never the content.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to browse the enterprise applications, so that I can see which apps are wired for SSO in my org.
expected: A grid with columns Id, Label, Subdomain, Status, Organization, Sort order, Created at loads sorted by Sort order ascending; search and the Status filter narrow the rows; the Organization column shows the org slug and never 'Global' for an Org Admin.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a Member, I want to be sure I cannot reach the apps list, so that tenancy is enforced.
expected: Navigating to the apps list URL returns the Not-Found page (HTTP 404), not Forbidden; the Apps sidebar group was never offered.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to delete an unused application, so that stale SSO targets are removed.
expected: Confirming Delete on an unused app removes the row; deleting an app still referenced by an SSO handoff shows an inline 'application in use' alert and the row remains.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to register a new app, so that users in my org can launch it via SSO.
expected: Submitting valid values redirects to the new app's detail page; re-submitting the same Id shows an 'already taken' error on the Id field with no navigation.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want the form to stop me submitting a non-HTTPS or untrusted origin, so that SSO redirects stay safe.
expected: A non-HTTPS origin shows an 'invalid origin' error; a well-formed HTTPS origin not on the allow-list shows 'origin not allowed'; each cleared required field shows its asterisk and a localized required message with a red border.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a Member, I want the create page to be unreachable, so that only managers can add apps.
expected: Opening the create URL returns the Not-Found page (404).

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to change an app's status and label, so that I can disable or rename it without recreating it.
expected: Editing Status and Label and clicking Save shows a success message; the values persist after reload; the Id is displayed read-only with no input.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a read-only admin, I want to inspect an app without being able to change it, so that least privilege holds.
expected: With admin.apps.read but not manage, every field is disabled and there is no Save button and no required legend.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want another org's app to be indistinguishable from a missing one, so that cross-tenant existence never leaks.
expected: Opening an appId owned by a different org returns Not Found (404), identical to opening a non-existent id.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to see whether the system tried to email a user, so that I can debug delivery.
expected: The outbox grid shows Created at, To, Subject, Template, Status newest first; the Status and Template filters narrow rows; View opens a panel with From/To/Template/Provider/timestamps and the body rendered as plain text.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to send a test email, so that I can confirm rendering and provider wiring end to end.
expected: Entering an address and clicking Send shows a delivery-status result and adds a new test_email row near the top; with no provider configured the status is 'logged'.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a read-only email admin, I want the outbox without the Send action, so that I cannot generate mail.
expected: With admin.email.read but not manage, the outbox grid renders but the Send test email control is absent.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a Member, I want the outbox to be unreachable, so that mail contents stay admin-only.
expected: Opening the outbox URL returns the Not-Found page (404).

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an admin, I want to see every template and locale, so that I know what the system can send.
expected: A table of Key, Locale, Subject, Updated at loads ordered by key then locale; a multi-locale key shows one row per locale with its localized subject.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a Member, I want the templates list to be unreachable, so that message copy stays admin-only.
expected: Opening the templates URL returns the Not-Found page (404).

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a Superadmin, I want to edit a template in a specific locale, so that I can adjust the wording users receive.
expected: Editing a non-English template's Subject and HTML body and clicking Save returns to the templates list, refreshes Updated at, and the changes persist on re-open; key and locale are read-only.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want a clear Forbidden result if I try to save a global template, so that platform config stays superadmin-controlled.
expected: An Org Admin can open the editor but clicking Save shows a red 'forbidden' alert with no redirect and no change; the template is unchanged when re-opened as Superadmin.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a Superadmin, I want required-field validation, so that I cannot ship an empty subject or body.
expected: Clearing the Subject or the HTML body shows a required error with a red border and blocks submission; Text body and Description are optional.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to review issued keys and their status, so that I can govern machine access.
expected: The grid shows Name, Prefix (drk_env_...), Owner, Scopes, Status, Last used, Expires, Created newest first; the prefix is always truncated and never a full secret; the Status filter and the detail panel work and contain no secret.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to rotate a key, so that I can replace a possibly-leaked secret without disruption.
expected: Confirming Rotate on an active key reveals a new secret exactly once with a copy button and once-only warning; the original key becomes Revoked and no longer offers Rotate/Revoke.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to revoke a key, so that I can cut off access immediately.
expected: Confirming Revoke on an active key flips its status to Revoked after refresh; the detail panel then shows Revoked-by and Revoked-at.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a read-only admin, I want the inventory without destructive controls, so that I can audit without acting.
expected: With admin.apikeys.read but not manage, rows show a View action only, and there is no New API key button and no Rotate/Revoke.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a Member, I want the governance list to be unreachable, so that only admins govern keys.
expected: Opening the API keys list URL returns the Not-Found page (404).

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to issue a scoped key for a user, so that their integration can call the API as themselves.
expected: Submitting a valid owner UUID and grantable scopes reveals the new drk_env_... secret exactly once with a copy button; closing the dialog returns to the list where the new key appears.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want clear errors when the owner is wrong or the scopes are too broad, so that I cannot mint an over-privileged key.
expected: A missing owner shows 'owner not found' (404); an inactive owner shows 'owner inactive' (409); scopes the owner lacks show an error naming the ungrantable scopes (422); a cleared Name shows a required error.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want a foreign-org user to look identical to a missing user, so that cross-tenant existence never leaks.
expected: Submitting the UUID of an active user in a different org returns 'owner not found' (404), indistinguishable from a non-existent id.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a Limited Admin, I want to scan recent activity, so that I can see who did what.
expected: With admin.audit.read the grid loads Created at, Event type, Outcome, Actor, Target newest first at page size 50; Outcome badges are colour-coded (success muted, error/denied destructive).

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want to filter the log, so that I can find a specific event class or actor.
expected: Setting Event type, Outcome, or Actor narrows the grid and updates the URL so a shared link reproduces the view; View opens a panel with actor, target ids, IP, user agent, reason, and full JSON metadata.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As an Org Admin, I want the log confined to my org, so that I never see another tenant's activity.
expected: Only the Org Admin's own org events appear; ORG B events and org-less platform events never show, and filtering by a foreign actor returns no rows.

area: Administrator: Apps, Email, API Keys & Audit
story: As a Member, I want the audit log unreachable, so that activity data stays admin-only.
expected: Opening the audit log URL returns the Not-Found page (404).

story: See every organization with its member count so I can pick one to administer.
expected: All seeded orgs appear with member count and status badge; a New organization button is visible; clicking a slug opens the org detail.

story: The list shows only my organization so I cannot see or act on other tenants.
expected: Exactly one row (org-a) is shown; no New organization button; searching org-b returns nothing (server-scoped).

story: The organizations screen is unreachable so non-tenancy users never see tenant data.
expected: Direct navigation returns Not Found (404), not Forbidden; the Organizations nav link is absent.

story: Filter and sort the list so I can find an org in a large estate.
expected: Status/Default filters narrow the rows; member-count sort re-orders and updates the URL; search matches slug/name.

story: Create a new organization so I can onboard a new tenant.
expected: Entering a unique slug and name and submitting creates the org and redirects to its detail page.

story: The create form is unreachable so I cannot spin up new tenants.
expected: Direct navigation to /organizations/new returns Not Found (404); no New organization button was ever shown.

story: Add a user to my organization so they gain membership.
expected: Adding an existing user by id creates an active membership row; the grid refreshes; the member name links to the user detail.

story: Remove a member so they lose access to the org.
expected: Confirming Remove deletes the row; a failed remove shows an inline alert; a repeat removal reports not found.

story: Bind and unbind a provider organization so SSO/provisioning maps to my org.
expected: Adding a binding shows a new row; removing and confirming deletes it; a duplicate provider+key is rejected.

story: Rename an organization and change its status so I can correct tenant records.
expected: Editing name/status and saving shows a success message; the header reflects the change on reload.

story: The Settings save is refused so I cannot mutate the org record at the platform level.
expected: Editing a field and saving is rejected with a forbidden inline alert (SUPERADMIN-only); the record is unchanged on reload.

story: A foreign organization is indistinguishable from a missing one so cross-tenant existence is never leaked.
expected: Opening a foreign org's detail URL returns Not Found (404), not Forbidden; a non-UUID id also returns 404.

story: Search memberships across all orgs so I can locate a user's tenancy footprint.
expected: Searching a cross-org member shows their membership in each of the three orgs; org and user cells link out.

story: The memberships screen is scoped to my org so I only see my own tenants' members.
expected: Every row belongs to org-a; a cross-org member appears only via their org-a membership; the status filter works.

story: The memberships screen is unreachable so membership data is not exposed to non-tenancy users.
expected: Direct navigation returns Not Found (404); the Memberships nav link is absent.

story: Create an org, add members, and confirm an Org Admin of that org sees only it so tenancy isolation holds end to end.
expected: New org is created and a member added; the Org Admin sees only their own org and gets 404 on the new org's URL; deleting an org with dependents returns 409.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to browse my org's roles, so that I can find the one to edit.
expected: A grid lists Key/Name/Scope/Organization/Permission count/Member count/Created; only my org's roles appear; search and sort work; clicking a key opens role detail.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to delete an unused role and be blocked from deleting one still in use.
expected: Deleting a role bundled into a group or assigned to a user is refused inline with the localized role-in-use message (409); a role with no user and no group reference deletes and the grid refreshes.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to duplicate a role to start a new one from an existing permission set.
expected: A copy is created with a -copy key suffix (subset-limited for a non-Superadmin) and I land on its detail page with the source permissions pre-assigned.

story: As a Member, I want roles administration hidden so that I cannot reach it.
expected: No Roles nav link is shown; opening the roles URL directly returns Not Found (404, never 403).

story: As an Org Admin, I want to create a role in my org to define a new bundle of permissions.
expected: No org picker; blank submit shows required errors on Key and Name; an invalid key pattern is rejected; a valid submit creates the role in my org and navigates to its detail; a duplicate key returns 409 on the Key field.

story: As a Superadmin, I want to create a Global or org-scoped role.
expected: The org picker includes a Global option; a Global role is created with no owning org (Global badge); choosing an org scopes it there; an org admin forging Global is rejected 403 server-side.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to add and remove permissions via the dual-list editor.
expected: Moving keys between Available and Assigned and clicking Save persists the diff (POST additions, DELETE removals) with a saved status; Save is disabled until dirty; a non-Superadmin adding an unheld key is refused 403 and the set is unchanged.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to see who holds a role.
expected: The Members tab lists users with email/name/organization/assigned-at; search filters; each email links to the user's admin detail.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to rename a role and edit its description while the key stays fixed.
expected: Key is read-only; clearing Name shows a required error; a valid Name/Description save persists with a saved status.

story: As an Org Admin, I want another tenant's role to be invisible.
expected: Opening a role UUID owned by another org or a Global role returns Not Found (404, not 403); an invalid non-UUID id also returns 404.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to browse groups to manage cohorts.
expected: A grid lists Key/Name/Role count/Member count/Created for my org only; the seed Engineering and Customer Support groups appear; search filters; clicking a key opens group detail.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to delete a group without stripping users' directly-held roles.
expected: Confirming delete removes the group and cascades its role bundles and memberships (no in-use block); a former member keeps any directly-assigned role.

story: As a Limited Admin, I want groups administration hidden so that I cannot reach it.
expected: The seed admin role lacks admin.groups.read; no Groups nav link; opening the groups URL returns Not Found (404, not 403).

story: As an Org Admin, I want to create a group to bundle roles for a cohort.
expected: No org picker; blank submit shows required errors; an invalid key pattern is rejected; a valid submit creates the group in my org and navigates to its detail; a duplicate key returns 409 on the Key field.

story: As a Superadmin, I want to create a group in a chosen org.
expected: The org picker has no Global option; submitting without an org shows an organization-required error; choosing an org creates the group there and navigates to its detail.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to bundle and unbundle roles on a group so its members gain or lose those roles.
expected: Moving roles between columns and Saving persists the diff with a saved status; only the group's own-org roles are offered (no foreign or Global roles).

story: As an Org Admin, I must not be able to bundle a role that out-authorizes me.
expected: Bundling a role whose conferred permissions include a key I do not hold (e.g. a superuser-granting role) is refused 403 with the localized forbidden message; a Superadmin can bundle it.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to add a user to a group so they inherit its roles.
expected: The Add member dialog's picker searches server-side and is org-scoped; selecting an active org member and submitting adds them and refreshes the grid; each email links to the user's detail.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to remove a member so they lose the group's conferred roles.
expected: Clicking Remove opens a destructive confirm showing the email; confirming removes the row and refreshes the grid; directly-assigned roles are untouched.

story: As an Org Admin, I want a clear message when a pick is not eligible.
expected: Adding a user who is not an active member of the group's org shows an inline not-eligible message (added:0 / 404); adding any member to a group conferring a role I lack the permissions of is refused 403.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to rename a group and edit its description.
expected: Key is read-only; clearing Name shows a required error; a valid Name/Description save persists with a saved status.

story: As an Org Admin, I want another tenant's group to be invisible.
expected: Opening a group UUID owned by another org returns Not Found (404, not 403).

story: As an Org Admin, I want to read the permission catalog and see which roles use a permission.
expected: With admin.roles.read the grid lists Key/Description/Used-by-N-roles; search filters; clicking the count opens a slide-over listing roles, each linking to its detail.

story: As an Org Admin, I want the catalog to stay read-only for me.
expected: The manage buttons appear (admin.platform includes admin.permissions.manage) but any edit or delete is refused with 403 (Superadmin-only writes) and nothing persists.

story: As a Superadmin, I want to edit a permission's description and delete an unused one.
expected: Editing a description persists (key read-only); deleting a permission still attached to a role is refused inline with permission-in-use (409); an unused permission deletes.

story: As a Member, I want the catalog hidden so that I cannot reach it.
expected: No Permissions nav link; opening the permissions URL returns Not Found (404, not 403).

story: As a Superadmin, I want to add a permission to the catalog.
expected: Blank submit shows a required Key error; an invalid key pattern is rejected; a valid submit creates the permission and returns to the catalog; a duplicate key returns 409 on the Key field.

story: As an Org Admin, I must not be able to create a catalog permission.
expected: The form opens (the role holds admin.permissions.manage) but submitting is refused 403 with a localized forbidden root error; no permission is created.

story: As a Member, I want the admin console to be invisible to me, so that the app never advertises tools I cannot use.
expected: Visiting /en/app/administrator or /users as a member returns the app Not Found page (HTTP 404) — not Forbidden and not a partial admin shell.

story: As an Org Admin, I want a sidebar that lists only the areas I can open, so that no link leads to a dead end.
expected: Every visible sidebar link opens its screen without a 404; a Limited Admin's sidebar shows only the Users and Audit entries.

story: As an Org Admin, I want an at-a-glance dashboard of my organization, so that I can see counts and recent activity without opening each area.
expected: Metric cards and recent-activity lists reflect ORG A only; clicking a card navigates to that area's list.

story: As a Superadmin, I want system-wide insight charts, so that I can compare organizations and spot platform-level trends.
expected: The Most active organizations chart and the audit-event-volume chart appear for a superadmin and are absent for an org admin.

story: As a Limited Admin, I want the dashboard to hide areas I cannot read, so that it never shows numbers I have no permission to see.
expected: Only the Users card and the registrations/audit lists render; no Organizations/Roles/Permissions/Apps cards and no sessions list.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to search and filter the user directory, so that I can find a specific person quickly.
expected: Search narrows to matching ORG A users; the status filter and column sort work; clicking an email opens that user's detail.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to approve several pending users at once, so that onboarding is fast.
expected: Selecting pending users and choosing Approve shows a success toast with the count and the rows refresh to active.

story: As a Limited Admin, I want the actions I lack to be hidden or refused, so that the screen never lets me start something I cannot finish.
expected: The New user button is absent; Approve succeeds but the Ban bulk action is refused (requires admin.users.ban) with no rows changed.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to export the current view to CSV, so that I can share or archive it.
expected: Clicking Export CSV downloads a CSV of the current filtered view.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to create a user, so that I can provision access on someone's behalf.
expected: Submitting valid input returns 201 and redirects to the new user's detail page with a Pending approval status badge.

story: As an Org Admin, I want clear validation, so that I fix mistakes before submitting.
expected: An invalid email shows a localized field error and error border; a blank password blocks submit; a duplicate email lands the 409 error on the email field.

story: As a Limited Admin, I want this page to be closed to me, so that I cannot create users I have no permission to create.
expected: Navigating to /en/app/administrator/users/new returns Not Found (404), not Forbidden; no form renders.

story: As an Org Admin, I want a user's key facts on one page, so that I can review their account at a glance.
expected: The detail page shows display name, email, a localized status badge, and the tab bar (Overview, Roles, Groups, Memberships, Sessions, Audit).

story: As an Org Admin, I want another tenant's user to be indistinguishable from a non-existent one, so that the app never leaks who exists elsewhere.
expected: Requesting an org-b user's id (or an unknown/non-UUID id) as orgadmin@orga.local returns Not Found (404), never Forbidden.

story: As a Limited Admin, I want to read a user's core identifiers, so that I can cross-reference them in logs and support tickets.
expected: The Overview tab shows email, display name, preferred locale, the app-user id, the Better Auth id, and a created/updated footer with localized dates.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to grant a user a role, so that they gain the capabilities that role confers.
expected: Opening the assign dialog, picking an ORG A role, and confirming adds it to the list; Remove deletes it after reload.

story: As a Limited Admin, I want role changes to be unavailable, so that I cannot alter permissions I have no authority over.
expected: The Roles tab lists assignments (read works) but shows no Assign button and no per-row Remove action.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to add a user to a group, so that they inherit the group's roles in one step.
expected: Adding the user to Engineering shows the group in their list; Remove deletes it after reload; already-joined groups are excluded from the picker.

story: As a Limited Admin, I want the Groups tab to reveal nothing, so that group membership stays confidential when I lack the group-read permission.
expected: The Groups list does not load (an inline load error, since the fetch is 403 without admin.groups.read) and no add/remove controls appear.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to see and manage a user's org memberships, so that I can correct their tenancy.
expected: The Memberships tab lists memberships with status badges and org links; Remove deletes a membership after confirming.

story: As a Limited Admin, I want membership removal to be unavailable, so that I cannot change tenancy without the update permission.
expected: The Memberships tab lists memberships (read works) but shows no per-row Remove action.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to revoke a user's sessions, so that I can cut off access immediately if a device is compromised.
expected: Active sessions list with expiry/IP/user agent; Revoke removes one and Revoke all clears them, signing the user out on next navigation.

story: As a Limited Admin, I want session data to stay hidden, so that IPs and devices are not exposed without the sessions permission.
expected: The Sessions list does not load (an inline error, since the fetch is 403 without admin.users.sessions) and no revoke controls act.

story: As an Org Admin, I want the history of what happened to a user, so that I can investigate incidents and support requests.
expected: The Audit tab lists the user's events newest-first; clicking a row opens a detail sheet with actor, target, IP, user agent, reason, and JSON metadata.

story: As a persona lacking audit permission, I want the Audit tab to be absent, so that audit data is gated separately from the user record.
expected: For a persona with admin.users.read but not admin.audit.read the tab bar has no Audit tab and the per-user audit API returns 403.

story: As an Org Admin, I want to act as a user to reproduce their problem, so that I can support them accurately; and I want a one-click way back.
expected: After ticking the acknowledgement and starting, the page reloads into the dashboard as the target with a Stop impersonating banner; Stop returns to the admin account.

story: As an admin, I want unsafe impersonations refused, so that impersonation cannot be used to escalate.
expected: Impersonate is disabled on one's own detail (self), and a non-superadmin targeting a more-privileged user is refused with a 403 escalation error.

story: As a new user I sign up, wait on the pending-approval screen, an Org Admin approves me from the Users list, then I sign in and land on the dashboard.
expected: New account is created as pending_approval and blocked from /app; after the Org Admin selects the row and clicks Approve the status badge shows Active; the user then signs in and lands on /app/dashboard.

story: As an Org Admin I create a group, bundle a role on its Roles tab, add a member on its Members tab; the member gains the capability and the matching admin nav link appears.
expected: The conferred role (admin.users.read) makes the Users nav link appear for the member and clicking it OPENS the users grid (it does NOT 404, because the nav key equals the page guard); removing the member from the group makes the link disappear and the page return Not Found.

screen: Direct role assignment on the User Roles tab
story: As an Org Admin I assign a role on the target user's Roles tab, verify the effective permission changes, then remove it.
expected: Assigning the Administrator role adds it to the user's role list and makes the admin nav links appear when that user reloads; removing the role and reloading makes the links disappear, confirming the effective permission set changed.

screen: Impersonation: impersonate, act, Stop returns to admin
story: As a Superadmin I impersonate a member, act with only the member's permissions, then Stop impersonating and return to my own admin session.
expected: After Impersonate the shell reloads as the target and admin screens 404; the impersonation banner shows a Stop button; clicking Stop restores the admin session and reloads to /app/dashboard, and admin screens open again.

screen: SSO handoff: launch from hub, consume at /sso/confirm
story: As a signed-in user I launch an enterprise app from the Applications switcher and consume the handoff on the satellite at /sso/confirm to land signed in.
expected: Clicking an app in the Applications sheet redirects through /api/sso/launch to the satellite; /sso/confirm shows the account email re-derived from the signed token and a Continue button; the same-origin POST burns the one-time token and signs the user in; reusing the token shows the invalid/expired screen.

screen: API-key lifecycle: create, call, rotate, revoke, rejected
story: As a user I create an API key, call /api/v1/me with it, rotate it, revoke it, and confirm the credential is rejected.
expected: Create shows the drk_ secret exactly once; GET /api/v1/me with Authorization: Bearer <secret> returns 200; after rotate the new secret returns 200 while the old secret returns 401; after revoke the current secret returns 401.

screen: Password reset: forgot, outbox email, reset, sign-in
story: As a member I request a password reset, read the reset link from the admin email outbox, reset my password, and sign in with the new one.
expected: Forgot-password returns a neutral anti-enumeration message; a password_reset row (status logged) appears in the outbox with a /reset-password?token= link; the reset form accepts the token and a new password; the member signs in with the new password; reusing the reset link shows an expired-token message.

screen: Org lifecycle as Superadmin: create, add members, assign roles, scope
story: As a Superadmin I create an organization, add a user into it, assign an admin role, then confirm an Org Admin of that org sees only it.
expected: Only a Superadmin can create the org (a non-superadmin API call is 403); the new user is created into the org and granted admin.platform; signing in as that Org Admin, Organizations lists only the new org, and cross-org resources return Not Found (404, not 403).

screen: Email: edit a template incl. a non-English locale, send test, view in outbox
story: As an admin I edit an email template (including a non-English-locale row), send a test email from the outbox toolbar, and view the result in the outbox.
expected: Each (key, locale) is its own editable row with an immutable key and locale; a saved edit persists; the Send test email action sends the test_email template through the outbox and its row detail shows the rendered subject and body; it works in a non-Latin UI locale with no raw message keys.

screen: Locale switch: Preferences localizes UI and next email
story: As a member I change my preferred locale in Preferences and confirm the UI and my next email localize.
expected: Saving a non-Latin locale refreshes the shell so navigation and headings render in that locale with no raw keys; triggering a user-addressed email (e.g. forgot-password) produces an outbox row whose subject and body are rendered in the recipient's chosen preferred locale.

story: Reach sign-up from the landing page via the create-account CTA
expected: Clicking the create-account hero CTA navigates to /en/sign-up and the sign-up card renders

story: Open the project GitHub from the primary hero CTA
expected: Primary hero button opens github.com/devresponse/devresponsekit in a new tab (target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer)

story: Switch site language from the brand bar
expected: Choosing Ukrainian changes the URL to /uk and re-renders hero/features/stats in Ukrainian with no raw message keys

story: Open the About page to learn what the product is
expected: /en/about renders an h1 brand name and a one-line placeholder description under the shared public brand bar

story: Open the public docs index
expected: /en/docs renders heading Documentation and the line Public-facing documentation index for a signed-out visitor (no redirect)

story: See a confirmation and a way back in after signing out
expected: Sign out redirects to /en/logged-out showing the You have been signed out alert with a working Sign in link

story: Reach the logged-out page directly
expected: Opening /en/logged-out directly renders the same signed-out alert and Sign in link with no redirect or secure API calls

story: Sign in with email and password to reach the dashboard
expected: Valid credentials sign the user in and redirect to /en/app/dashboard (sanitized returnTo default)

story: Be returned to the deep-linked secure page after signing in
expected: Signed-out access to /en/app/workspace redirects to sign-in with returnTo; after sign-in the user lands on /en/app/workspace

story: See a generic error for a wrong password
expected: Submitting a real email with a wrong password shows a role=alert reading Invalid email or password and stays on the sign-in page

story: Register a new account to request access
expected: A fresh email with a password of 8+ chars creates the account and redirects to /en/pending-approval

story: Be blocked from submitting a too-short password
expected: A password under 8 chars shows Password must be at least 8 characters under the Password field with an error border and no navigation

story: Request a password-reset link
expected: Submitting a valid email replaces the form with the If an account exists confirmation (role=status) and records a reset email in the outbox

story: Get the same confirmation for an unknown email (anti-enumeration)
expected: Submitting an email with no account shows the identical If an account exists confirmation with no user-not-found hint

story: Set a new password from a valid reset link
expected: A valid token plus two matching 8+ char passwords resets the password and shows Your password has been updated with a Sign in link

story: Be blocked when the two passwords do not match
expected: Two different passwords show Passwords do not match under Confirm password and the form does not submit

story: See an invalid-link message when no token is present
expected: Opening /en/reset-password with no token renders This reset link is invalid or has expired plus a Request a new link to /en/forgot-password (no form)

story: Be told the account awaits approval
expected: A signed-in pending user hitting any secure page is redirected to /en/pending-approval showing the pending alert and a Sign out button; retrying /en/app/dashboard re-redirects

story: See a clear access-restricted message
expected: A blocked/suspended/deactivated user hitting a secure page is redirected to /en/blocked?reason=status showing the destructive restricted alert and a Sign out button, with no moderation detail leaked

story: Confirm which account is being signed into via SSO handoff
expected: A valid handoff token shows Confirm sign-in with the re-verified email and a Continue button; Continue POSTs same-origin to /api/sso/consume and establishes the session

story: See an invalid message for a bad or expired handoff link
expected: A missing or tampered token renders Sign-in link invalid with a Back to sign in link and no Continue form
